en: Vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a busy urban street lined with multi‑storey European-style buildings. People in early 20th‑century dress walk and stand along the street; some men wear hats and long coats. A large tree dominates the center of the view, partially obscuring a prominent building on the left with classical columns and an ornate fence. Printed captions in Greek and French appear on the image, along with a modern watermark at the bottom right.
